title: Physics Formula Reference
description: 3 captured saves. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain. Includes the saves once listed as Formula Lookup.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: PHYSICS FORMULA REFERENCE
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end marker, byte-identical matching variants/repeated saves; runtime untested
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
90 POKE16553,255
100 INPUT"WHAT SHOULD I SEARCH FOR";S$:L=LEN(S$)
110 READF$:LF=LEN(F$):IFF$="DONE"THEN1000ELSEFORX%=1TOLF:IFMID$(F$,X%,L)=S$THENPRINTF$:GOTO110
120 NEXT:GOTO110
1000 PRINT"<<<<DONE>>>>":RESTORE:PRINT:GOTO100
10010 DATA"DENSITY=MASS/VOLUME","PRESSURE=FORCE/AREA","PRESSURE=DENSITY*HEIGHT(OR DEPTH)","FORCE1/FORCE2=AREA1/AREA2","WORK=FORCE*DISTANCE","FORCE1*DISTANCE1=FORCE2=DISTANCE2","KINETIC ENERGY=1/2*MASS*VELOCITY[2"
10020 DATA"PRESSURE1*VOLUME1/TEMPURTURE2=PRESSURE2*VOLUME2/TEMPERTURE1","PRESSURE*VOLUME=NUMBER OF MOLES*UNIVERSAL GAS CONSTANT*TEMPERTURE"
10030 DATA"COEFFICIENT OF FRICTION=FORCE OF FRICTION/NORMAL FORCE TO SURFACE","AVERAGE VELOCITY=DISTANCE/TIME","ACCELERATION=FINAL VELOCITY-INITIAL VELOCITY) /TIME","FORCE=MASS*ACCELERATION","PENDULUM: PERIOD=2*PI*SQR(LENGTH/ACCELERATION OF GRAVITY)"
10040 DATA"ENERGY=MASS*VELOCITY OF LIGHT[2","SINE=OPPOSITE/HYPOTHENUSE","COSINE=ADJACENT/HYPOTHENUSE","TANGENT=OPPOSITE/ADJACENT"
10050 DATA"SPECIFIC GRAVITY OF H2O(WATER)=1.00","CM[3=1 ML","1 L OF AIR(S.T.P.)=1.293 G","1034G/CM[3=1ATM=76CM=760TORR","UNIVERSAL GAS CONSTANT=0.0821 L ATM MOLE[-1 K[-1","0 CENTIGRADE (CELUSES)=273 KELVIN"
10060 DATA"ENERGY IS NEITHER CREATED OR DESTROYED","POTENTIAL ENERGY=MASS*ACCELEERATION OF GRAVITY * VERTICAL DISTANCE(HEIGHT)","POWER=WORK/TIME","1 HP(HORSE POWER)=746 WATTS","WORK=COSINE(A)*FORCE*DISTANCE","WORK=KINETIC ENERGY"
10070 DATA"1 HORSEPOWER(HP)=550 FOOT*POUNDS/SECOND(FT-LB/SEC)","IDEAL MECHANICAL ADVANTAGE=DISTANCE FORCE MOVES/DISTANCE LOADMOVES","ACTUAL MACHANICAL ADVANTAGE=FORCE EXERTED BY MACHINE/FORCE USED TO OPERATE MACHINE"
